observations: Photo 0 shows a used automotive transmission with a 3.6L engine attached.
The transmission casing is stamped with 'CA' and '0084'.
The engine and transmission are surrounded by other used parts in a workshop or scrap yard environment.
There is visible rust and dirt on the transmission input/output shafts.
No manufacturer logos, part numbers, or model identification plates are legible in the photos.

claims.evidence: No Jeep logo or 3.6L engine identification plate is visible in the photos.
No year or model identification is visible on the transmission or engine.
No documentation or label in the photos confirms this.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The transmission may be damaged internally (e.g., gears, bearings, or seals).
risks.proof: A video of the transmission being operated through all gears.

risks.risk: The engine may be a different model or year than the one claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate.

risks.risk: The transmission may be a used or rebuilt unit with unknown service history.
risks.proof: A photo of the transmission service history or a rebuild certificate.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine identification plate (usually on the engine block).
Video of the transmission being shifted through all gears.
Photo of the transmission service history or rebuild certificate.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
